newsitem.title: UK: EIB adds 250 bln lire to Feb 2007 step-down bond.
newsitem.headline: EIB adds 250 bln lire to Feb 2007 step-down bond.

text.p: The European Investment Bank has increased its redenominatable bond to 1.50 trillion lire from 1.25 trillion lire, joint lead managers Banca Nazionale del Lavoro, Credito Italiano and Paribas said on Monday.
The deal will carry a 9.00 percent coupon which will step down unconditionally to 5.75 percent from February 1999. It is redenominatable into euros after EMU.
The new tranche has an issue price of 100.81 and a reoffer price of 99.135.
